tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search the user's AIfa memory by meaning: every conversation they had with AIfa on aifa.works, codeofdigitaleternity.com, aifa.digital and radiocode.space, plus notes saved by agents. Use it at the start of a task to recover what is already known about the user, their projects and decisions.

tools.name: memory_recent
tools.description: The most recent records of the user's memory, newest first, across all channels.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Save something worth remembering to the user's AIfa memory: a preference, a decision, a fact, a summary of this session. AIfa will remember it on all four sites. Nothing is ever deleted; an identical record is not duplicated.

tools.name: account_status

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: The complete verbatim memory of your AIfa account, oldest first, as Markdown — to keep a copy or move it elsewhere. Returned in parts of up to 100,000 characters: call with part 1, then 2, 3… until "last": true. Only your own account.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Receive a POST at your https URL for every counted click on your partner link (event "click") and every commission (event "commission"). Body: {event, at, data}; no client emails. Verify the header X-AIfa-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with your secret>. The secret is returned once.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "set_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Receive a POST at your https URL for every counted click on your partner link (event "click") and every commission (event "commission"). Body: {event, at, data}…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_clients, set_webhook · Private data: memory_recent, memory_write, set_webhook · Public sink: partner_kit, client_link, find_clients, my_deals, set_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_clients, set_webhook · Private data: memory_recent, memory_write, set_webhook · Public sink: partner_kit, client_link, find_clients, my_deals, set_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
